scope: Read-only static audit of public environment, dependency, package, path, platform, and determinism surfaces.

executive_assessment.fresh_clone_without_private_scientific_d: The public package and RCC can be inspected from a fresh clone, and an editable core install is plausibly supported by pyproject.toml. No complete, tested install recipe or lock proves this on a clean host.
executive_assessment.standalone_wheel_status: NOT_PROVEN; repository-root schema files are not declared as package data and default schema lookup assumes a source-tree layout.
executive_assessment.same_machine_implication: Existing exact-version receipts and local custody can support narrowly authorized replay, but the current checkout alone is not a self-contained replay environment.
executive_assessment.public_release_implication: A source-and-synthetic release is feasible after dependency and entrypoint documentation; exact scientific replay requires separately authorized data and private authorities that must remain outside Git.

path_and_machine_assumptions.finding: Canonical and v6 schema registries default to Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] and read repository-root schemas. pyproject.toml does not declare those schemas as package data.
path_and_machine_assumptions.implication: Editable/source-tree execution is supported by design evidence, but a standalone wheel or relocated package-data layout is not proven.

path_and_machine_assumptions.finding: Scientific custody uses explicit environment variables for data, model, threshold, registry, and locator roots; these values must remain outside Git.
path_and_machine_assumptions.implication: This is a security boundary, not a defect, but fresh-machine scientific replay needs a documented path-silent binding procedure and separately supplied assets.
evidence: src/paperworks/v6/task039e3_r2r_d0_execution_authorization_v1.py:sanitized dataset, preprocessing, model, and threshold environment interfaces

path_and_machine_assumptions.finding: The exact GDN remediation environment requires absolute, distinct external roots outside the repository and is frozen to windows-amd64.
path_and_machine_assumptions.implication: The old exact GDN run is not a platform-neutral recipe; VALIDATION V2 needs either the same exact environment capsule or a newly versioned and validated environment contract.

path_and_machine_assumptions.finding: The RCC convenience launcher is a Windows batch file and includes a host-cache interpreter fallback.
path_and_machine_assumptions.implication: RCC Python scripts remain path-relative and portable; only the convenience launch path is Windows-specific.

path_and_machine_assumptions.finding: Historical task reports and setup documents contain host-specific launcher examples and environment-era instructions.
path_and_machine_assumptions.implication: They are provenance, not a current fresh-machine recipe; release instructions must avoid copying those locators and must provide sanitized commands.

path_and_machine_assumptions.finding: CSV/JSON paths generally use explicit UTF-8 or UTF-8-SIG encodings, LF writing, stable sorting, and UTC timestamps.
path_and_machine_assumptions.implication: Encoding, line-ending, ordering, and timezone drift are substantially mitigated in audited current code.

findings.title: Scientific dependencies are not represented by one complete lock
findings.finding: pyproject.toml pins jsonschema and optional Torch/PyG but omits the frozen D0/STAT NumPy dependency and all test tooling; no root requirements lock, uv/Poetry/Pipenv lock, Conda environment, .python-version, tox, or CI workflow is tracked.
findings.effect: A fresh clone cannot reconstruct or verify the full scientific/test environment from package metadata alone.
findings.recommended_future_action: Create a versioned VALIDATION V2 environment manifest and resolved lock(s), separating core, test, numerical, GDN, and optional provider surfaces; do not alter PILOT V1 receipts.

findings.title: Repository-layout dependency prevents claiming standalone package portability
findings.finding: Schema discovery derives the repository root from module location and reads schemas outside the Python package, while package metadata does not install schema resources.
findings.effect: Source/editable execution may work, but a normal wheel install is not evidenced as functional for canonical contracts.
findings.recommended_future_action: Before release, package schemas/resources or require and test an explicit repository-root contract. Verify both editable and intended release installation modes on a clean host.

findings.title: Scientific replay depends on intentionally external private assets
findings.finding: HAI payloads, D0 preprocessing/model/threshold authorities, rule numeric authorities, and task-specific custody registries are environment-bound and excluded from Git.
findings.effect: Public code reproduction and synthetic smoke can be separated from scientific replay, but PILOT V1 or VALIDATION V2 scientific recomputation cannot start from a clone alone.
findings.recommended_future_action: Define a path-silent restoration manifest and authorization procedure with logical IDs/hashes, without redistributing restricted payloads.

findings.title: Exact GDN environment is reproducible only under a narrow frozen platform contract
findings.finding: The audited GDN environment is CPython 3.12.13, windows-amd64, exact wheel identities, CPU-only, and four external roots with fixed thread/hash variables.
findings.effect: This is stronger than an unpinned install but not cross-platform portability. A generic .[gdn] install is not equivalent to the frozen scientific environment.
findings.recommended_future_action: For EXP-01, either restore the exact environment from verified wheel receipts or version and validate a new environment before results; never silently substitute a generic backend.

findings.title: D0 pins Python and NumPy but not the full numerical implementation identity
findings.finding: D0 fails closed on CPython 3.12.13 and NumPy 2.3.5 and uses float64 eigendecomposition, but inspected public receipts do not freeze NumPy wheel hash, BLAS/LAPACK vendor, CPU instruction behavior, or thread variables.
findings.effect: Prediction artifacts are integrity-traceable, but exact fresh-machine recomputation is not guaranteed solely by version strings.
findings.recommended_future_action: Freeze wheel hashes and numeric backend/thread metadata for VALIDATION V2, then use tolerance/exactness policies appropriate to artifact identity.

findings.title: Fresh-clone instructions and test environment are incomplete
findings.finding: The root README documents only the optional GDN editable install; it does not provide a current core/dev install, full test command, supported platform matrix, asset restoration flow, or synthetic end-to-end smoke. Test imports include undeclared pytest and NumPy.
findings.effect: A new machine operator must infer setup from historical reports and local conventions.
findings.recommended_future_action: Publish one sanitized, staged reproduction guide and machine-readable dependency groups before fresh-machine rehearsal.

findings.title: Git and source-tree state are runtime governance dependencies
findings.finding: Multiple scientific authorization modules invoke Git and verify ancestry/source closure from a repository checkout rather than from an installed package artifact.
findings.effect: A source archive or wheel without .git cannot satisfy all historical execution gates; the intended VALIDATION V2 release/run mode must be explicit.
findings.recommended_future_action: Choose whether validation executes from an exact Git checkout or from a signed release manifest, and test that chosen mode.

findings.title: Windows-specific RCC launcher is convenience debt, not a scientific blocker
findings.finding: open_dashboard.bat searches Windows launchers and a per-user bundled interpreter fallback, while the underlying RCC Python scripts resolve paths relative to themselves and use stdlib only.
findings.effect: Dashboard convenience is Windows-biased, but RCC generation can be documented cross-platform without changing scientific code.
findings.recommended_future_action: Add a portable command to release documentation; a cross-platform wrapper is optional.

findings.title: Provider SDK is not an installation blocker
findings.finding: Historical construction transport uses Python stdlib urllib and explicitly records no provider SDK dependency. Credential/network/model availability remains an EXP-03 operational dependency only.
findings.effect: Core contracts, fixed-rule runtime, RCC, and synthetic smoke need no provider SDK, credential, or network.
findings.recommended_future_action: Keep provider transport in an explicit optional EXP-03 profile and never include credentials in the release.

findings.title: Core serialization is mostly explicit and stable
findings.finding: Audited current modules generally specify UTF-8/UTF-8-SIG, LF output, stable ordering, canonical JSON hashing, UTC timestamps, and CPU execution where scientific backends require it.
findings.effect: Locale, timezone, line-ending, and unordered-container risks are reduced, though fresh-machine rehearsal remains required.
findings.recommended_future_action: Preserve these contracts and add targeted cross-platform synthetic checks rather than broad refactoring.

dependency_boundary_conclusions.core_import: jsonschema is the only declared runtime dependency; Torch/PyG are intentionally lazy and optional.
dependency_boundary_conclusions.scientific_numeric: NumPy 2.3.5 is authoritative for the frozen D0 path but missing from project dependency metadata.
dependency_boundary_conclusions.gdn: Exact scientific GDN restoration is an environment-receipt problem, not merely pip install -e .[gdn].
dependency_boundary_conclusions.provider: No SDK dependency; network and credential are future authorized construction dependencies, never fixed-rule runtime dependencies.
dependency_boundary_conclusions.tests: RCC tests are stdlib-oriented, but the whole repository test population has undeclared pytest/NumPy/optional-backend requirements.
dependency_boundary_conclusions.containers: ARGOS container locks are isolated historical-reference environments and should not be merged into the v6 release environment.

controls: single-thread MKL/OMP/OpenBLAS environment in exact remediation contract
gdn.remaining_risk: A generic optional dependency install bypasses the exact environment identity; use only a versioned validated backend for EXP-01.

d0.remaining_risk: Numerical wheel/BLAS/thread identity is incomplete for fresh recomputation.

rule_runtime_and_rcc.remaining_risk: Repository/Git and private-authority restoration mode must be frozen for VALIDATION V2.

fresh_machine_rehearsal_implications: Stage 1 should use an exact Git commit and record Python, OS, architecture, Git, installer, and resolved package identities.
Stage 2 should install only a public core/test profile and verify imports without private data, credentials, Torch, or network.
Stage 3 should explicitly test schema loading in the intended release mode; editable install success must not stand in for wheel success.
Stage 4 should run RCC and synthetic contract tests; the full historical suite requires separately declared pytest/NumPy/optional profiles.
Stage 5 should run a synthetic candidate-to-metric smoke with no scientific assets.
Stage 6 should verify that private environment variables are absent and fail closed before any authorized restoration.
Only a later separately authorized stage may restore HAI/private authorities by logical identity and hashes.
Scientific execution must use a new VALIDATION V2 environment identity; PILOT V1 artifacts remain immutable.

gap000_implications.GAP-011_fresh_machine: Retain as ENGINEERING_HARDENING with urgency P1 before held-out execution; it need not block read-only design work or public synthetic preparation.
gap000_implications.GAP-012_metric_portability: Retain; environment and packaging gaps confirm that shared metric replay needs an explicit dependency/entrypoint capsule.
gap000_implications.GAP-013_split_conformance: No environment evidence changes its disposition.
gap000_implications.GAP-001_authority: The bridge option adds a dual-schema/resource packaging and test burden but best preserves V4 runtime reuse if the bridge is explicitly versioned and verified. Environment evidence does not permanently decide the option.
gap000_implications.new_root_blocker: No new global scientific blocker beyond the existing fresh-machine/environment hardening root; ENV-001 and ENV-002 should be tracked as sub-findings of GAP-011/GAP-012.

uncertainties: No clean-host install was executed, so installability classifications are static assessments, not reproduction results.
No wheel was built or inspected; standalone-wheel failure is a source-supported risk, not an observed execution failure.
The availability of exact external GDN wheels and private restoration assets was not probed.
The current host's installed package inventory was not used as authority.
BLAS/LAPACK implementation identity for the frozen D0 NumPy wheel was not found in the inspected public receipts.
Historical environment-specific documents are extensive; this audit distinguishes active source contracts from provenance without treating every legacy command as current authority.
